question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
-- Get top 5 constructors with most seasons as lowest point-scorers
WITH constructor_season_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, cr.constructor_id, c.name, SUM(cr.points) as total_points
    FROM constructor_results cr
    JOIN races r ON cr.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, cr.constructor_id, c.name
    HAVING SUM(cr.points) > 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, name, total_points,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points ASC) as rk
    FROM constructor_season_points
)
SELECT name, COUNT(*) as seasons_as_last
FROM ranked
WHERE rk = 1
GROUP BY name
ORDER BY seasons_as_last DESC, name ASC
LIMIT 5
